notes.title: 📢 Step Into the Saloon — It’s Almost Showtime
notes.notes:
We’re nearing the Early Access release of Fillet Fury, and the tension at the table is higher than ever.

🖼️ Here’s the screenshot breakdown that just went live on the Steam page — giving you a clear look at the gameplay in motion and how the UI pulls everything together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514010/28c8ff690708861cfde1f6ce06fd70acdcdbb0eb.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Top Half — Countdown & Combat[/b]

The top half of this screenshot captures the moment just before the chaos:

A high-stakes timer ticks down, building pressure before the knife drops.

Every moment is a decision — wait too long, or move too early, and the consequences are immediate.

This is Fillet Fury’s rhythm: tense, precise, and brutally unforgiving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514010/3f3373a36e09fb34552f9d15270fef051bdfcd43.png[/img]

[b]🧩 Bottom Half — UI & Core Systems[/b]

The lower section highlights how the gameplay systems come together:

The interface balances clarity with intensity — letting you focus while staying immersed.

Decisions made here shape the entire round: whether you block, stab, or gamble everything.

The UI is built to reinforce that every move matters.

[b]🖤 Wishlist & Join the Saloon[/b]

We’re heading toward Early Access fast. Be the first to play and shape the future of the game:
